title: retire-gpo input
description: Retire a foreign GPO in steps. start (domain admin, not stored): full copy, rights of the module group on this GPO, Preferences rewritten to take back what the computers keep, waiting period. cancel (domain admin): the GPO as it was, also its owner and rights. delete: after the waiting period, remove links, object and SYSVOL folder on the DC of the settings.

days.description: Waiting period (start only); default from the settings

admin_user.description: Domain admin (start and cancel), used once

confirm_registry.description: Registry Preferences the computers delete during the waiting period (refs of the inventory)

confirm_audit.description: The admin knows that deleting a GPO with an advanced audit policy clears all advanced auditing of the computers
